device.model: HD X4 220 (System ID 06020200, Amstar UPC 1.5.22.VI build)
device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver with CA card reader / CI variants (HD X402p / X403p / X4 family)
device.board: 06020200 (Globo / Opticum M3602B "220" platform with Lemontree EuP front-panel MCU)
device.soc: ALi M3602B (bootloader "M3602B 1.1.6"; NIM_S3501_0, NIM_COFDM_0, DMX_S3601_0, DECV_AVC_0, DECV_S3601_0, OSD_S36_0/1, VPO_S3601)
device.demod: ALi S3501 DVB-S2 on SCB1 at I2C 0x33
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 DVB-S2 on SCB1 at I2C 0x60

source.author: Globo / Opticum (Amstar UPC mod)
source.note: Archive ALI3602_06020200_X4_amstar_UPC_1.5.22.VI.rar from the Opticum / Opticum HD X402-X403-X4-X7 directory on satedu.cba.pl.

simulator.note: Boots as an M3602B board (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_x4_amstar_upc_app_starts.py, run_dump_x4_amstar_upc_capture_screen.py): the "M3602B 1.1.6" bootloader communicates with the external Lemontree front-panel and EuP standby microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged SCL = GPIO 62 / SDA = GPIO 171 using 8-byte CRC-16/XMODEM frames (updating the 4-digit 7-segment display " ON " -> "    " -> " on "), prints "APP  init ok", unpacks maincode(AV) (6.38 MB) to 0x80008000, and starts the single-CPU application.  The application configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60 on SCB1, and renders its blue Hungarian Amstar UPC OSD dialog ("HW probléma, kérem lépjen kapcsolatba viszonteladójával!") through GeM3602 (7 GE commands, 4 colours).

desc: Opticum HD X4 220 (System ID 06020200) firmware 1.5.22.VI with the Amstar UPC GUI (2012-03-18) on a 4 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3602B Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver.

Uses the external Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit 7-segment front-panel microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on GPIO 62 / 171 (CRC-16/XMODEM protocol, " ON " -> " on "), an ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and an Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60.
